Marked contrast enhancement (Enhancement Quality) and substantial necrosis (Proportion Necrosis) and edema (Proportion of Oedema) are radiologic hallmarks of IDH-wildtype high‑grade glioma. Multifocal disease (Multifocal or Multicentric) and deep white‑matter invasion (Deep WM invasion) further support a wildtype phenotype. Cortical involvement (Cortical involvement) and a relatively high cortical proportion (Region Proportions) are more common in IDH‑mutant tumors and thus argue against mutant status.
